mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a temperature of 79 degrees, though please note the air quality is currently moderate at 53.
The City of Verona has closed entries for the student I Voted sticker design contest, with public voting scheduled to run from July 28 through August 7 to select winners from four grade categories.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O-W-I after his vehicle was found stuck on a rock.
The flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload, but since the store is currently closed, you can head over when they open at 10:00 AM; if you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Snickers Swirl.
